motivation.interpretation: Different attention reduction order perturbs low-probability logits. Raw-logit equality is retained as telemetry, while the prospective gate tests decoded behavior and normalized probability mass.

execution_order: Confirm the complete Task 1 sparse requests under the declared gate.
Run one held-out sparse request or task without changing thresholds.
Admit autonomous tail-90 evidence only if both exact-token and probability-distance conditions pass.
claim_boundary: The exploratory observation does not qualify tail-90. A confirmation on the same task is not held-out evidence, and no production-default gate is claimed until held-out replication.
